note.en: Read as a ratio of percentage changes (T20).

definition.zh-TW: 營業利益變動一些時，稅前淨利會放大變動多少倍。利息負擔越重，槓桿度越大，表示借錢經營放大了股東的獲利與風險。
definition.en: How many times more profit before tax moves when operating profit moves. A heavier interest burden means a higher degree: borrowing magnifies both the shareholders' gains and their risk.

ifrsNote.zh-TW: IFRS 不定義財務比率；這個名稱是國際通用說法，計算口徑以指標登錄檔的版本為準。
ifrsNote.en: IFRS does not define financial ratios. The name follows international usage; the calculation basis is the version in the ratio registry.
